title: Bairs Campfires
description: slightly more realistic campfire setup, makes it a good alternative to beds in the early game.
body:
makes campfires a little bit more useful:

On the go sleeping! Don't want to bring a bed and mess up your spawn? Just make a campfire! You will be able to sleep through the night (wip, rn it just sets to daytime :/) without setting your spawn!

More interactive! Add fuel to your campfire so you can light it, and because you are a survival expert, you can just use sticks to light it.

also the campfire recipe is a little cheaper now, no coal or charcoal needed

very much wip still:
- better sleeping integration
- custom textures
- effects/differences between fuels


Fuels:

<summary>Spoiler</summary>
coal
sticks (prolly remove this later)
